title: Quinoa, Blueberry and Avocado Salad
excerpt: Enjoy a fresh, colorful salad combining quinoa, creamy avocado and blueberries for a perfect sweet-and-tart touch.
imageAlt: Fresh quinoa salad with avocado and blueberries in a ceramic bowl.
steps: Rinse the quinoa very well under cold water and cook it in two cups of boiling water with a pinch of salt for about 15 minutes until soft.
Remove the quinoa from the heat, let it rest covered for 10 minutes and then fluff it with a fork in a deep bowl.
Add the finely chopped fresh spinach and mix gently with the warm quinoa.
Very carefully fold in the avocado cubes and the high-mountain blueberries grown in Guasca, ideal for adding a natural, balanced sweetness to the dish.
Make the dressing by mixing the lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper in a small bowl.
Pour the dressing over the salad right before serving and toss with gentle movements so you don’t bruise the ingredients.
tips: To better preserve the natural bloom and firmness of your blueberries, keep them in the fridge unwashed and in their original packaging until you are ready to use them.
If you prefer a crunchy touch, you can add a handful of toasted almonds or chopped walnuts on top when serving.
